smell_rule_desc: Reports a method (Pylint message E9901) whose body embeds the implementations of the sub-methods it should delegate to. Absorption is measured with a normalized statement-shape longest common subsequence between the method body and each helper body reachable in the project call graph (names erased, call targets and constants kept, return statements excluded as delegation interface). A helper counts as absorbed with >=3 matched statements at >=0.75 coverage; the relation is reported when >=2 distinct helpers are absorbed, their matched statements total >=12, the method is thereby oversized, and at least one absorbed helper itself delegates to another absorbed helper, i.e. the collapse spans multiple levels of the original hierarchy. Any repair that delegates again - to the original helpers or to newly extracted, well-scoped sub-methods - removes the message.
